description: This file defines the `GenericCredential` class, which extends `CommonCredential`. It models a generic credential with type, secrets, and additional properties, supporting JSON serialization/deserialization with Jackson annotations.

classes.name: GenericCredential
classes.description: Represents a generic credential with a type, secrets, and additional properties, used in device authentication within the Eclipse Hono framework.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the credential type name that reflects the authentication mechanism for devices.

methods.name: getSecrets
methods.description: Returns the list of secrets associated with this credential.

methods.name: setSecrets
methods.description: Sets the list of secrets for the credential, throws IllegalArgumentException if the list is empty.

methods.name: setAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Sets additional arbitrary properties for this credential.

methods.name: getAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Returns the map of additional properties.
